issue.body: Is there anyway I can default all endpoints to require authentication instead of explicitly requiring it on every endpoint?  I mean a use case for most applications is that only a small subset of endpoints **do not** require authentication, and I haven't yet found documentation that lets me say "by default an endpoint should require authentication, and only when annotated with `@somedecorator` should a  no authentication be allowed".  This was extremely easy to do in flask.
issue.title: Authentication Middleware Default Required
